primary_risk: Dependence on a few large customers
sector_survival_note: The optical communication sector is prone to disruption, but Lumentum's technology and customer base provide some durability.
thesis_summary: Lumentum's high-speed optical communication technology rides the trend of increasing data transmission demands.
thesis_breaks_if: A structural shift to alternative technologies or a significant decline in customer demand.
sentiment_note: Valuation is EXTREME, but the company's durability and growth runway justify a starter position.
ten_k_highlights: Revenue has been falling over the past 5 years, but gross margin has been rising.
The company has a stable share count and no dilution.
The optical communication market is expected to continue growing, driven by increasing demand for high-speed data transmission.
valuation_note: FCF yield 0.3%, PEG 0.6, EV/EBITDA 117, P/S 26 — very richly valued — starter position only.
implied_growth_note: The price assumes near-perfect execution for a decade — start small.
priced_for_perfection_note: Price already assumes ~45%/yr growth for a decade — start small, add on weakness
